purpose: Validate the Computer Use-owned concrete perception-provider delivery/selection boundary independently from OCR correctness, target resolution and action execution, using the optional local macOS Vision text-region provider on the reference Mac.
requiredClaims: Computer Use owns perception-provider description, availability and selection through a dedicated perception-provider manager separate from application Provider management.
The selected concrete provider declares id, locality, text-region capability and explicit runtime availability.
The first concrete provider is optional and local: rumiai.local.macos-vision-text-region.
The provider declares network=false, account=false and cloudApi=false; no network/account/cloud dependency is required for selection.
Default provider selection requests locality=local and does not silently fall back to a remote provider when local capability is unavailable.
Selection is deterministic by required capability, requested locality and provider id ordering.
Provider selection does not invoke observe(), does not capture a frame and does not execute OCR.
Physical validation establishes real macOS local-provider availability/selection only; OCR correctness is deliberately outside this checkpoint.
P2B remains provider-neutral and contains no macOS Vision or Swift-specific assumptions.
Computer Control remains unchanged and provider-free at e3a3f13d66546cf8f0fca50075bd4607c2c3d003.
P5A/P5B/P5C contract regressions remain passing and P1-P4 physical validations are not rerun.
Computer Use and Computer Control working trees remain clean after the session.
nonClaims: P5D does not claim OCR accuracy for arbitrary screenshots or applications.
P5D does not run a visual capture, target resolver, fallback policy, pointer action or postcondition verifier in its physical selection test.
P5D does not wire provider selection into the normal agent loop; that remains P5E.
P5D does not introduce implicit remote-provider fallback or require any remote provider.
P5D does not broaden the P2B observation schema beyond the already validated text-region contract.
P5D does not move provider code into Computer Control.
P5D does not rerun or rewrite P1-P4, P5A or P5C physical evidence.
P5D does not rewrite any failed P5C session; s01-s07 remain immutable historical evidence.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact product/test/toolchain failure and fix forward in a new session.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: The P5D physical selection test captures no screenshot, executes no OCR, persists no recognized text and performs no input action.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P5E first normal agent-loop end-to-end semantic-first visual fallback task
